speakerposition: Deputy Chair of Committees of the Whole
speechtext:
I have the honour to inform the House that a message has been received from the Senate informing this House that the Senate has passed the following bills without amendment: Bill C-3, an act respecting the acquisition, administration and disposition of real property by the Government of Canada; Bill C-18, an act to amend the Income Tax Act, the Canada Pension Plan, the Cultural Property Export and Import Act, the Income Tkx Conventions Interpretation Act, the Thx Court of Canada Act, the Unemployment Insurance Act, the Canada-Newfoundland Atlantic Accord Implementation Act, the Canada-Nova Scotia Offshore Petroleum Resources Accord Implementation Act and certain related acts; Bill C-20, an act to amend certain statutes to amend the budget tabled in Parliament on February 26, 1991; and Bill C-38, an act to provide for the continuance of Telesat Canada under the Canada Business Corporations Act and for the disposal of shares therein of Her Majesty in the right of Canada.
I have the honour to inform the House that a message has been received from the Senate informing this House that the Senate has passed Bill C-47, an act for granting Her Majesty certain sums of money for the Public Service of Canada for the financial year ending March 31, 1992.

speakerposition: Deputy Chair of Committees of the Whole
speechtext:
I have the honour to inform the House that a communication has been received as follows:
Rideau Hall,
Ottawa
Sir,
I have the honour to inform you that the Honourable William Stevenson, Puisne Judge of the Supreme Court of Canada, in his capacity as Deputy Governor General, will proceed to the Senate chamber today, the 17th day of December, 1991, at 4 p.m., for the purpose of giving Royal Assent to certain bills.
Yours sincerely,
Judith A. LaRocque,
Secretary to the Governor General.
A message was delivered by the Gentleman Usher of the Black Rod as follows:
Mr. Speaker, the Honourable Deputy to the Governor General desires the immediate attendance of this honourable House in the chamber of the honourable the Senate.
Accordingly, Mr. Speaker with the House went up to the Senate chamber.
And being returned:

speakerposition: Deputy Chair of Committees of the Whole
speechtext:
I have the honour to inform the House that when the House went up to the Senate chamber the Deputy Governor General was pleased to give, in Her Majesty's name, the Royal Assent to the following bills:
Bill C-3, an act respecting the acquisition, administration and disposition of real property by the Government of Canada-Chapter No. 50.
Bill C-18, an act to amend the Income "Ihx Act, the Canada Pension Plan, the Cultural Property Export and Import Act, the Income Thx Conventions Interpretation Act, the Tkx Court of Canada Act, the Unemployment Insurance Act, the Canada-Newfoundland Atlantic Accord Implementation Act, the Canada-Nova Scotia Offshore Petroleum Resources Accord Implementation Act and certain related acts-Chapter No. 49.
Bill C-20, an act to amend certain statutes to implement the budget tabled in Parliament on February 26, 1991-Chapter No. 51.

Royal Assent
Bill C-38, an act to provide for the continuance of Telesat Canada under the Canada Business Corporations Act and for the disposal of the shares therein of Her Majesty in right of Canada-Chapter No. 52.
Bill C-47, an act for granting to Her Majesty certain sums of money for the public service of Canada for the financial year ending the 31st March, 1992.-Chapter No. 53.
It being 4.20 o'clock p.m., pursuant to order made Tuesday, December 10, 1991, this House stands further adjourned until Monday, February 3, 1992 at 11 a.m., pursuant to Standing Orders 28(2) and 24(1).
May you all have a merry Christmas and a happy New Year.
